scope: Independent source review of the Done helper diagnostic and its reviewer projection/tests. No browser, product source, workflow, or repository edits.
sourceAssessment: The phase labels align with the actual Done helper sequence: session creation; DOM.enable; getDocument, host query/describe, button query/describe; box model; hit lookup; trusted mouse click; finally detach.

The first caught helper error is retained. If detach also throws, the existing first error and its phase remain; a detach-only failure is reported at phase detach. The reviewer runner copies only allowlisted phase/category/boolean and finite bounded box fields, then wraps failures using a safe enum; raw error message, protocol IDs, and guest/page values do not enter the projected proof.

Data picker selection count is required to equal one before Done. On Done failure the runner continues its existing picker Cancel and DataView Cancel cleanup attempts. Post-Done checks still require one selected DataView field, cancel readiness, and guest explanation before selector verification; no save/auth path was introduced.

covers: Done failure path and existing cleanup attempts
testAssessment.gap: The driver fault loop injects a detach-only failure, and separately injects failures at earlier phases; it does not combine an earlier failure with a second detach failure and assert that the original error/phase is preserved. The implementation correctly suppresses the secondary detach exception when firstError exists, so this is a focused test-coverage gap rather than an observed source correctness failure.

limitations: Exact Store candidate/native behavior remains pending; this report is not a product fix, native pass, or candidate acceptance claim.
The combined first-error-plus-detach-error case should be added to the fault-injection suite for a complete proof of the stated preservation rule.
cleanup: No browser/profile state changed; no source edits or commits made.
